instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short report (120–150 words) for a community group. Compare two possible projects for a local park: a small playground (low cost, good for families) and a sports centre (high cost, good for all ages). Use passive sentences and order words (first, then, finally). End with a short recommendation.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
